content: The management and treatment goals for LDL cholesterol, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), emphasize the importance of combination therapy in certain cases. For individuals at high cardiovascular risk, the addition of ezetimibe or PCSK9 inhibitors to statin therapy may be considered to achieve optimal lipid-lowering effects. High-intensity statin therapy alone has been demonstrated to significantly reduce the incidence of cardiovascular events in individuals classified as high-risk.
